title: Parametric elliptic reconstructions and a posteriori error estimates for parabolic partial differential equations with small randomness in a Robin boundary condition
summary: We obtain reliable a posteriori residual-based error estimates for parabolic partial differential equations with small randomness in a Robin-type boundary condition. The uncertainty is addressed via a perturbation approach, transforming the problem with small random input data into a sequence of deterministic problems. Finite element approximations, combined with the backward Euler time discretization, are employed for the resulting problems.
